name: hawk
description: Language support for Hawk, a productive programming language for LLMs and coding agents.

hawk.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace folder) whose files should not show Hawk diagnostics in the editor. The language server still analyzes these files — this only hides their diagnostics in VS Code, so `hawk check` and the conformance harness are unaffected. Example: `tests/lang/**` hides the intentionally-broken language-conformance tests.

hawk.path.markdownDescription: The path to the `hawk` CLI executable (used for both the language server and Run/Test). If empty, the extension auto-detects `hawk` on your `PATH` and, failing that, prompts you to locate the Hawk SDK — storing the result here. Changing this takes effect after `Hawk: Restart Language Server` or reloading the window.
